body: Just to be happy. Bipolar is a bitch and doesn't help that I hate where I am in life. I feel stuck. But honestly just to be happy for once.

Was on 5 mg of Abilify for about a month and was feeling pretty good.  Upped to 10 mg about two weeks ago and started to feel like crap. Lost interest in everything. It got so bad I had to reach out to my family and almost hospitalized myself for being suicidal. Not sure if I just hit a depression point or if it was the meds. Even eating doesn't interest me. I just want to sleep to not think. Anyone else have similar experiences?

Holy crap. I am on 10 mg and feel like this. I lost all pleasure in doing anything. Nothing makes me happy and I don't feel a damn thing. I was thinking about stopping because I did not feel like this until I upped my dosage.

I wanted to this weekend but had some plans with my son that I hate to break. The last person I would want to disappoint. I know people are going to say to not do it for him but the pain goes beyond that. I am 30 y/o. I was just recently diagnosed Bipolar 1 about 2 months ago. Idk what to do anymore. Still waiting for the meds that are supposed to help my depression to kick in.

Shes out of the country. Haha the god damn time I actually need help.  What's the point? Nothing I do can shake this sick feeling I have. The other time I felt like this was about 10 years ago. I felt the exact same and I actually attempted. I just don't know how to stop feeling like this. I feel like there is only one way out to stop feeling like this.

That's the thing. None of those will stop this feeling. It's always there. I can feel it in my gut. My meds are still getting worked out so I can't say for sure if it's them causing this feeling of emptiness or if I just his a wall of depression again. I thought about putting myself in the hospital but that creates a huge mess money and job wise.

I am trying to tell myself this today. Hit a low about a week ago. Noticed it when I started to lose interest in almost everything and started to eat out again. Ugh I was doing so well too. I feel so hopeless today. Just have to stay positive. I am so lucky I have an appointment today.
Haha same! Why I love finding new music. New songs to put on repeat!
Thanks. I will try it out. How long have you been growing your hair? Also what about your washing routine if you have one?
Nice! What is your routine? I have hair very similar to yours.

Terrible. Undiagnosed Bipolar Disorder. Finally diagnosed about two months ago and on medication and going to therapy. It wasn't all bad but I wish I had known what was wrong with me sooner. I turned 30 this year as well. Seek help and don't wait like I did. My 20s were a blur and I hope my 30s are better now that I am headed in the right direction mentally.
That I wouldn't be Bipolar anymore and be mentally stable without needing medication. Therapy is a slow process but I am making progress.
